name: test_prod_requires_every_origin_explicitly_and_ignores_local_env_files
description:
Objective: Production requires explicit origins and never loads local QA/Staging env files.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Import config.settings in a subprocess with ENV=prod and no origins.
Expected: 1. Import fails naming the missing explicit settings.
